SCE.S:164054: Works at my office. Mother is from Hong Kong. Good at moving fast.
SCE.S:164120: My school friend. Does "space-time" research on his father's money. The government watches it.
SCE.S:1641EC: His family has baked in the Old Town for generations. Closer to God than any churchman, but unaware of it.
SCE.S:1642B8: Studies religious archaeology. Her theory: a village with its own cosmic faith stood here by 200 AD.
SCE.S:164384: Young and devout. As a boy he saw a lovely woman float down by his window, but recalls it only dimly.
SCE.S:164450: As a young Nietzsche fan she'd say "God is dead these days." Deep down, she still believes in something higher.
SCE.S:16451C: To him God is just an idea to debate with colleagues. Hobby: yachting. (At sea, he's nearer to God.)
SCE.S:1645E8: Kept the mine's books since high school and ran the church youth group. Fired two months ago.
SCE.S:1646B4: The church's old "Four Churches" system comes from a lost civilization once here.
SCE.S:164780: He studied the church's vast ancient texts. Some held more than even its long-kept secrets.
SCE.S:16484C: A priest of this special church faces many crises of faith. He has weathered them; now comes the worst.
SCE.S:164918: On his 12th birthday his father, also a priest, taught him the four churches' duties. It sounded like sci-fi.
SCE.S:1649E4: The church's eldest. He has watched the City change for ages, but his heart dwells in eternity.
SCE.S:164AB0: Mole people like him moved from subways and basements into the labyrinth. They come up at night for food.
SCE.S:164B7C: Well loved. Guards this door day and night. His eyes are always fixed on eternity.
SCE.S:164C48: To him the "anomaly" is the Day Of Judgment. The fact that the bishops "changed" the most, shook him.
SCE.S:164DE0: The "anomaly" was too hard a trial for his shaky faith. Whisked away by the "change," he became a "holy war" knight.
SCE.S:164EAC: Always guards the bell tower's bishop. He feels this isn't God's way, but religious instinct drives him.
SCE.S:164F78: The "anomaly" freed the dark side he'd held down. Church and faith stopped mattering. He took up a rifle.
SCE.S:165044: The bishop's right hand for 20 years.
SCE.S:165110: Came to the City with the bishop. Now the bishop has changed, he can only follow. The three are one.
SCE.S:1651DC: He aimed to serve as bishop and rise. That unspoken ambition is what ruined him.
SCE.S:17C2E8: Beyond here are the stairs to the bell tower, but they're closed to visitors at the moment.
SCE.S:17C3E8: Such a grand cathedral feels out of place in this town, doesn't it? And yet, it stands here as testament to our faith.
SCE.S:17C494: A very old church. The first one was built here in the year 800.
SCE.S:17C544: My parents don't believe in priests at all. But the priests are good people.
SCE.S:17C5F8: Welcome to the church. Why not start by coming to the Monday service?
SCE.S:17C6A8: Something seems to have happened at the church. The priests are badly shaken.
SCE.S:17C758: You can't go in the back.
SCE.S:17FF50: We felt we had to hide "this." It lies beyond this door, up the stairs. In truth... I can't even begin to fathom "this"... Please, be careful.
SCE.S:1800A0: To reach the mystery beyond, the doors of the "Four Churches" must be opened. You have opened the hearts of all the "churches," all four pastors. My master is in the cellar. Go and meet him.
SCE.S:1801E0: To reach the mystery beyond, the doors of the "Four Churches" must be opened. Where are the "Four Churches," you ask? They are inside this church.
SCE.S:1802D8: To reach the mystery beyond, the doors of the "Four Churches" must be opened. ...A "church" is, in truth, nothing other than a person. The "Four Churches" here means the four pastors. It seems you have already opened the doors of some of the "churches."
SCE.S:1804DC: We felt we had to hide "this." It lies beyond this door, up the stairs. In truth... I can't even begin to fathom "this"... Please, be careful.
SCE.S:18062C: Have you met my master? I can no longer judge whether this door should be opened. Please ask my master, who is in the cellar.
SCE.S:180774: To reach the mystery beyond, the doors of the "Four Churches" must be opened. But the doors have been shut forever. The "Four Churches" meant the four pastors.
SCE.S:180A34: {6}Do you know how the world was created?
SCE.S:180AB0: {6}Let there be "light"! We three who are one have never felt such joy at God's omnipresence since we were born.
SCE.S:180B60:
{6}We have drawn near to God. Or, rather, drawn away from God? In principle we drew near, but in reality drew away? ...Ah, the confusion is taking hold again.
I no longer know."
SCE.S:180C50:
{6}It is the clashing of three separate souls that breeds chaos during the fusion.
But it's all right now... I think.
SCE.S:180CE4: {6}...Welcome to the house of God. Let me say it again. I am this church's bishop. I am the first and the last. I am pure faith itself. I shall baptize you by eating your sinful flesh!
SCE.S:181430: I had a dream. A giant whale washed up on the shore.
SCE.S:1814D4: This church's origins seem to be ancient. I've been looking into it, but the church people suddenly stopped cooperating.
SCE.S:1815AC: Don't you hear a sound from above? Like something heavy being dragged, something scraping?
SCE.S:181660: My husband was supposed to come to this church to worship yesterday, but he hasn't come home by morning. The priests here are hiding something!
SCE.S:181750: A reporter? These strange rumors are a problem for us. Please don't spread them any further.
SCE.S:181800: Ah, you're the guy from the newspaper. I'm the one who sent the e-mail. The priest should be in the bell tower in the back, but they won't let me see him. What's going on here?!
SCE.S:1818E4: This is a wonderful place. We must pass it on forever.
SCE.S:181988: This symbol has been passed down within the church. Made long after the fact, of course.
SCE.S:181A3C: Consumption rests upon many sacrifices. Within that cruelty... I see divine providence.
SCE.S:181AFC: Only when the final bell tolls, and the Day of Judgement arrives, do we truly believe in God. How sinful humanity is.
SCE.S:181BD0:
Here lie the ancient founders. They were not 'human' as we are. They brought us the 'Teachings', the truth of the universe and the divine.
The 'Four Churches' were merely an institution built to preserve those 'Teachings.'
When the three Archbishops began to transform, it was not their physical appearance that terrified us most, but their minds.
Their thoughts began to mirror the 'Teachings' with horrifying precision. They were not from this realm, they have become a pure manifestation of the 'Teachings'.
We hid the three of them away in the bell tower. Part of us did so to protect the faith of this region. Part of us, to safeguard the 'Teachings.'
...But something has gone deeply wrong.
Here, take the key to the bell tower stairs.
And be careful. On those steps are fanatics who will resort to extreme measures to defend the Archbishops."
SCE.S:181EF8: This door leads to the bell tower in the upper church.
SCE.S:181F98: {6}Repent. The kingdom of God is at hand.
SCE.S:182020: {6}The greatest miracle is about to happen now. But for you, it ends here.
SCE.S:1820C0: I hear you've been investigating here. Truth be told, we are deeply bewildered ourselves. If God sent you to protect this place, then we entrust it to you. ...I am called the "First Church."
SCE.S:182200: I am the "Second Church." The "Four Churches" is a system handed down through generations to protect this place. It is very old. In fact, older than the first missionary's arrival here. We only want to protect this inherited place of faith.
SCE.S:18235C: I can't bear it anymore. "Those people" are still changing "up there." Personally, I don't want to admit it's a divine mystery. Something very confused dwells in those once-gentle "people." I am the "Third Church." If the other three agree, I'll open the door for you.
SCE.S:1824F8: I am what's called the "Fourth Church." The Elder is secluded in the cellar. We'll leave the final judgment to him. If "those people" upstairs are the church's public face, the Elder is its other, older face. Here is the cellar key. Go down behind the chapel apse.
SCE.S:187294: The stairs to the bell tower have been sealed.
SCE.S:187380: My father and grandfather, all of us, have kept protecting this church.
SCE.S:187424: An ancient god was originally worshipped at this place. Passages built back then seem to remain underground.
SCE.S:1874FC: My husband's remains were found in the church bell tower. Those people were eating humans!
SCE.S:1875B8: {6}Why do you fools get in the way? We were going to draw near to God.
SCE.S:187664: This incident has tested me, and has only reinfoced my devotion.
SCE.S:187718: This church really has two faces, but the other face was hidden to avoid the Inquisition.
SCE.S:1877EC: Actually, this isn't merely a symbol. Legends say an "energy vortex" resides here.
SCE.S:1878B4: For over fifty years I've been in charge of cooking everyone's meals.
SCE.S:187964: The one who built this cathedral was the mine's owner, the late Mr. Yamasaki. The church is old, but this building is actually recent.
SCE.S:187A48:
Grrrggh...
This is the town's subterranean realm. Our domain. It reaches far and wide.
SCE.S:187AEC: This door has been sealed. A great many human bones were found in the bell tower.
SCE.S:18A298: The stairs to the bell tower have been sealed.
SCE.S:18A370:
We do not understand what occurred here, either.
Yet, somehow... something was protected.
SCE.S:18A428: This door has been sealed. One can only hope the incident will be forgotten soon.
SCE.S:18CA80: This is the house of God. Leave this place at once.
SCE.S:18CBF4: There was a huge passage under the church. But something's down there.
SCE.S:18CC98: {6}So you've come over here too. Now that it's come to this, I think I can understand what the vision I saw as a child was.
SCE.S:18CD78:
{6}Close your eyes.
You can feel the light pouring down, can't you?
SCE.S:18CE2C:
You're the newspaper reporter, aren't you?
What in the world... even you... what on Earth is going on here?!
SCE.S:18CEDC: This church has changed its function. It has become a base for converting consciousness into energy, a kind of gas station for the mind.
SCE.S:18CFB8: Everyone is delighted, but this state makes me uneasy. It resembles the "teachings," but is fundamentally different. Oh, someone else's mind has connected again.
SCE.S:18D0BC: Faith is merely a state of energy. This is what I believe now.
SCE.S:18D16C: We take no side, neither the people's nor yours. We are independent beings.
SCE.S:18D218:
There are a precious few true humans remaining here.
I cannot risk getting involved with them.
